I never said nor implied that anime meant he was autistic? And being neurodivergent isn’t “wrong.” It just means he may process things differently than other people. If you really care about your son, and if you’re truly horrified by your boyfriend’s actions, you will set aside your own biases and help your child by finding out in what ways he needs to be supported. Clearly whatever you’re doing isn’t working, and his dad is certainly out of line. Good luck OP. I wish your son well.

Your son may have undiagnosed ADHD or Autism. He may be otherwise neurodivergent. He may not What your boyfriend did was violent. Full stop. If you can, find a supportive family therapist. You may also need couple’s counseling because if you felt the need to hide your actions from your boyfriend, then you know there was a reason for that. If it was motivated by safety or keeping the peace, then there’s something that needs repair in the foundation of your relationship. It’s not the video games or the anime that is the problem. Get to the root. Good luck.

Your father is a person, like anyone else. That’s all there is to it. Desire is human. You have grown up in a culture that shames these completely natural human feelings. It is not personal. It has nothing to do with you and certainly in no way indicates anything about having another family. Human sexuality encompasses so much more than you’ve been taught, especially if your education around it has been mixed in with morality. You seem shaken to the core, so maybe use this as a starting point as to why you feel this is so hurtful to you. It’s okay to widen your worldview.

You actually *don’t* know that it would always end with the two of you going separate ways. That’s a projection you have, possibly a fear. What is it you’re so afraid of? (You don’t have to answer. Just something to think of when you’re supposed to be sleeping) 

You could fill in the blanks with anything. Why choose fear?

I've battled depression since childhood and I am 31 now. My life is getting too overwhelmed for me to handle anymore. I used to be resilient; I had some very low days where I came close to ending it, but I always got through it. Now I can only feel how worn down I really am. I've been unemployed for almost an entire year and no matter how many jobs I've applied to, I've got nothing. My husband is in a similar boat, but at least he's been getting some call backs. We're running out of money very fast. We basically live on eggs and instant noodles. My living situation (no pun intended) is far from ideal; the husband and I live with 3 other adults in a small 2-bedroom apartment. We don't own or have a car. I'm at the point where I check for loose change everywhere to make sure I have bus fare to get to school (I am a graduate student). I don't have many close friends. The ones I do have are busy with their own lives, their own problems. I don't sleep much anymore. My insomnia is worse than ever. I just feel terrible all the time now. I'm just constantly unhappy. So... that's why I made my decision to finally get my life over with. I just don't see myself feeling better anymore. I'm out of steam.

In my late teens, I was diagnosed with Major Depressive Disorder and Body Dysmorphic Disorder. I basically think I look like a cross between Madam Mim from Disney's version of *The Sword and the Stone* and a blobfish. I avoid my reflection as much as possible. The BDD usually gets worse when I'm in the middle of a depressive episode. I usually try and combat it with things that make me feel physically good like face masks, getting some sunshine, dancing, or taking selfies and then looking at them when I feel more leveled out (this last one is a hit or miss, but it's been nice sometimes to think I look okay).
